items.text: Rockies trade Case Williams and Jeff Hoffman to the Reds for Jameson Hannah and Robert Stephenson
Padres trade Jaff Decker and Miles Mikolas to the Pirates for Alex Dickerson
Brewers trade Doug Davis, Dana Eveland and Dave Krynzel to the Diamondbacks for Johnny Estrada, Claudio Vargas and Greg Aquino
Phillies trade cash and Jim Thome to the White Sox for Aaron Rowand and Daniel Haigwood
Marlins trade Derrek Lee to the Cubs for Hee-Seop Choi and Mike Nannini
White Sox trade Ed Correa and Scott Fletcher to the Rangers for Wayne Tolleson and Dave Schmidt
Angels trade Jim McGlothlin, Vern Geishert and Pedro Borbon to the Reds for Alex Johnson and Chico Ruiz

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
